title: Item 11b · Which cards Camps gets
subtitle: Item 11 decided: cards everywhere. Every roster gets the row of count cards, and tapping a card filters the list. Camps is the one roster without cards, so this question is which four it gets. Assumed — tell me if not: Black Belt keeps its own four plan cards (Paid in full · Paying on schedule · Late · Not paid) in the same look; Finance's Daily report keeps its cards as they are (a report, not a roster). (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data; the April camp's numbers are its real preview records)

columns.label: Today

items.caption: 1. Camps: one summary line — “15 coming on Mon, Apr 19 · 6 to collect · $1,355” — that can't be tapped.
2. The card row every other roster has (Color Belt shown): four cards, and tapping one filters the list.

columns.note: The April camp today: 19 campers, 13 paid, 6 still owe $1,355 (one of them is the possible duplicate; Leo Kim paid $335 and owes $15), $3,795 recorded, 15 coming on its first day.

columns.label: Two ways to give Camps the cards

items.caption: 3. A · the same four as Color Belt and Star: Campers · Paid · Not paid · Payments recorded; “15 coming on Mon, Apr 19” stays as a line above.
4. B · recommended — Camps' own four, the same cards: Campers · Coming Mon, Apr 19 · To collect · Payments recorded. Tap “Coming” → only that day's campers; “To collect” → only who still owes.

columns.note: Copies what's already there: the event roster's own card row and icons, filled with the camp's numbers. “Payments recorded” stays a total, as everywhere. Pictures 3–4 are drawn over the real camp page; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question:
A · The same four cards as Color Belt and Star (picture 3). + exactly the same card words in every roster. − the camp desk's two main numbers become a plain line (“15 coming”) and a “Not paid” card that also counts Leo Kim, who paid $335 and owes $15.
B · Recommended: Camps' own four, in the same cards (picture 4). Campers · Coming (that day) · To collect · Payments recorded. + leads with what the desk needs on a camp morning, and both can be tapped; the same look and tapping as every roster, the way Black Belt's four fit its plans. − the card words differ from Color Belt's and Star's.
